title: Mo Xiansheng's True Face
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's figure began to dissipate, leaving behind only a chilling warning: 'On the chessboard of the Heavenly Eye, you and I are merely pieces.'

text.content: The air in the depths of the ruins seemed frozen for ten thousand years. Chen Ji stood alone before the mechanism left by his father, his fingers gently touching the mottled stone door. An icy chill traveled through his fingertips, while the Tianji Record in his chest grew slightly warm, as if responding to the lingering aura within this space. He took a deep breath, silently reciting the formula his father had left behind. The stone door slowly opened, revealing a dark passage beyond. Both sides of the corridor were carved with obscure runes, markings passed down through generations of the Chen family. Chen Ji walked in slowly, each step stepping upon the footprints of his ancestors. An inexplicable emotion surged in his heart—anticipation, anxiety, and an irrepressible excitement. Mo Xiansheng had said that here lay his father's final secret, the riddle he must solve on this journey.

dialogue.content: "You've finally arrived." An aged yet gentle voice rang in Chen Ji's ear.

text.content: Chen Ji spun around abruptly. Mo Xiansheng's figure slowly materialized from the void, more clearly than ever before. His features were no longer vague light and shadow, but presented an aged texture of having weathered countless hardships. Flowing white beard and hair trembled slightly in the windless air, while his deep eyes flickered with complex brilliance. Mo Xiansheng gazed at Chen Ji, his eyes full of gratification and emotion, as if looking at an old friend he had waited a long time to see. "All these years, I've been watching you in the shadows." Mo Xiansheng's voice was soft, yet carried the weight of a thousand jun, "Watching you grow from a confused youth, step by step to where you are today." Chen Ji opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but found his throat choked. This mysterious existence had accompanied him for so long, and now finally revealed his true face.

dialogue.content: "Ji'er, do you know how your father and I met?" Mo Xiansheng smiled faintly, that smile carrying traces of nostalgia. "Thirty years ago, he and I both entered the Tianji Record lineage. He was the master, I the辅助. At that time, the Tianji Record had nine pages. He and I each held one page, vowing to uncover the truth of Heavenly Secrets and the wheel of fate."

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned. Thirty years ago, his father was still a spirited young man, yet this residual soul before him shared such a profound bond with his father. He had always thought Mo Xiansheng was merely a spirit born within the Tianji Record, never imagining he was actually a close friend who had fought side by side with his father. Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense his shock and sighed gently: 'Your father was the best friend of my life, and also the most qualified person to inherit the complete Tianji Record. Unfortunately, the Heavenly Eye不允许真正的预言者出现，它要将一切威胁其统治的力量扼杀在萌芽之中。' Mo Xiansheng's voice gradually grew heavy, 'Your father was personally erased by it.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, his fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood seeping through his fingers. He felt a fire burning in his chest—that was the anger and grief suppressed for so long. 'Heavenly Eye...' he repeated through gritted teeth, the name carrying profound hatred, 'Why did it kill my father? The Tianji Record is merely the ability to foresee the future—why must it be so wary?'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: 'Because a true seer can see through its layout. The Heavenly Eye is not fair heaven's will—it is a conscious existence, manipulating the fate of the entire cultivation world. It needs humans to struggle upon its chessboard, so it can draw power from this, sustaining its own existence. And seers are its greatest threat—because we can see through its chess game, making everyone realize they are merely pieces.' Mo Xiansheng's gaze turned sharp, 'Your father, precisely because he discovered this truth, was regarded as a thorn in its flesh, a threat to be eliminated.' Chen Ji felt his worldview collapsing. So the world he had always lived in was actually a cage manipulated by a higher being.

dialogue.content: "This jade slip, your father entrusted me to pass it to you before he died." Mo Xiansheng took out an antique jade slip from his sleeve, warm and smooth to the touch. "Inside are his lifetime cultivation insights, as well as the ultimate secret technique he comprehended from the Tianji Record. He knew he might not survive long, so he left this legacy in advance, hoping someday to deliver it into your hands."

text.content: Chen Ji extended his trembling hands to receive the jade slip. The moment it touched his palms, a familiar aura rushed toward him. That was his father's aura—warm and profound, like a large hand gently stroking his head. Chen Ji's eyes instantly grew moist. How many years had it been? Countless times he had seen his father's vague figure in dreams, yet never had he felt his father's presence so realistically. He pressed the jade slip tightly against his chest, as if embracing a long-missed embrace. Mo Xiansheng watched him quietly, a flash of heartache flickering in his eyes: 'Although your father has passed, he never gave up on protecting you. He sealed a wisp of his soul within the jade slip, hoping that someday he could meet you.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji held his father's relic, his emotions surging. How should he face this heavy legacy?

choices.text: Immediately activate his father's residual soul
choices.description: Have a conversation with his father that transcends life and death. Even if it's only a wisp of residual soul, he must hear what he wants to say.
choices.risk_hint: The residual soul's condition is unstable and may not be able to transmit information completely
choices.process_label: 你将手掌按在玉简上，引导一丝灵力注入其中。

dialogue.content: "Father..." Chen Ji called out softly, slowly pouring spiritual power into the jade slip. The jade slip immediately burst forth with soft radiance. A vague figure gradually condensed within the light—that silhouette... it was his father!

text.content: Although that figure was vague, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented warmth pierce through his heart's defenses. How many years had it been? He finally saw his father's appearance again, even if only a wisp of dissipating residual soul. Tears fell silently, yet Chen Ji smiled—that was a relieved smile, a smile of finally letting go of his emotional guard. Mo Xiansheng watched this scene quietly beside him, his own eyes unexpectedly growing moist.

choices.text: First put it away safely, activate it another day
choices.description: This emotion is too heavy. He needs to first organize his feelings before facing his father's residual soul.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain calm judgment, gain Mo Xiansheng's appreciation
choices.risk_hint: The residual soul has a time limit and may gradually dissipate
choices.process_label: 你将玉简贴身收入怀中，轻声说道："父亲，请您再等我些时日。"

dialogue.content: "Good child." Mo Xiansheng nodded, a flash of appreciation flickering in his eyes. "You are much calmer than I imagined. If your father has knowledge of this in the underworld, he would surely be proud of you."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip close to his body, its warm touch seemingly carrying his father's body temperature. He raised his head, his gaze turning sharp once more: "Mo Xiansheng, besides the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, were there any other participants in my father's death?" Mo Xiansheng's expression suddenly darkened: "There were. And this person is still by your side, right here within the Tianqing Sect."

choices.text: Inquire about the weaknesses of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.description: Compared to grief, the more important matter now is to find a way to deal with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence: "The Fatal Flaw of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets"
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be holding something back
choices.process_label: 你强压下心中的悲伤，目光灼灼地盯着墨先生："知己知彼，方能百战不殆。"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng, what exactly is the Eye of Heavenly Secrets? Since it could kill my father, it must have formidable strength—I want to know where its weakness lies." Chen Ji's voice regained its composure, the steadiness forged through countless life-and-death struggles.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng was slightly stunned, then a hint of appreciation flickered in his eyes: "You can remain calm in such circumstances—you truly are his son." He paused, lowering his voice, "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets is not invincible. Its greatest weakness is that it relies on mortal faith to sustain its existence. As long as no one believes in its existence, it will gradually weaken. And the Tianji Record in your hands is precisely the only tool that can expose its true nature."

The air within the ruins seemed to solidify. Mo Xiansheng's figure appeared increasingly ethereal in the dim light. He slowly walked to Chen Ji's front, meeting his gaze at such a close distance for the first time. "Over these years, I have watched you grow from someone mocked by everyone—a废物—step by step to where you are today." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a sense of emotion, "You are more patient and more dangerous than your father. This is both your advantage and your hidden peril." Chen Ji listened quietly, not interrupting. He knew that what Mo Xiansheng was about to say would determine his future path.

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' scheme is far more profound than you can imagine." Mo Xiansheng's expression grew solemn, "You think you are a chess piece, but in truth, you are merely an insignificant speck of dust on the chessboard. It has been scheming for ten thousand years, pulling the entire cultivation world into its chess game. Your father discovered this, so it wanted to kill one to warn a hundred. And now, the reason it hasn't made a move on you yet is because it is waiting—for you to gather enough Tianji Record fragments, for you to grow strong enough, and then it will strike to kill you in one blow."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He had always thought he was struggling against fate, never expecting that from the very beginning, he had already been incorporated into the enemy's scheme. This feeling was like an ant believing it could conquer a mountain, not realizing it was merely a game in the palm of a giant. Rage, humiliation, defiance... various emotions churned in his chest, but in the end, they all transformed into an even more resolute determination. Since the Eye of Heavenly Secrets intended to wait until he grew stronger before killing him, then he would overturn this chess game before it could make its move! As if seeing through his thoughts, a trace of gratified smile appeared at the corner of Mo Xiansheng's mouth: "You and your father are the same—people who refuse to bow to fate."

choice.prompt: Faced with this shocking truth, how should Chen Ji respond to Mo Xiansheng?

choices.description: Express to Mo Xiansheng his determination to slay the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Mo Xiansheng's full support and unlock the "Master and Disciple United as One" bond
choices.risk_hint: An oath too high-profile may be exploited by those with ulterior motives
choices.process_label: 你单膝跪地，向墨先生行了一个大礼。

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets killed my father and manipulated my fate, so I share a blood feud with it that cannot be resolved!" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the ruins, carrying unwavering resolve, "One day, I will personally drag this so-called Heaven from its divine throne!"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure suddenly blazed with dazzling light—that was a power he, as a remnant soul, had never displayed before. He stretched out his hand and gently tapped the void. A warm beam of light merged into Chen Ji's brow center. "This is a secret technique my father and I comprehended together in our final years—'Tianji Unity.' From now on, I will teach you everything I have learned in my life, bit by bit." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried unprecedented solemnity, "You are not fighting alone. I will always be by your side, until the day the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is destroyed."

choices.text: Remain calm and ask for guidance
choices.description: Revenge is important, but at present, he still needs more accumulation.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Mo Xiansheng's systematic guidance and unlock the "Remnant Soul Inheritance" function
choices.risk_hint: Being overly cautious may cause one to miss certain opportunities
choices.process_label: 你深吸一口气，平复了心中的波澜。

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's teachings, Chen Ji will forever keep in his heart." You respectfully clasped your hands and said, "But with my current strength, trying to oppose the Eye of Heavenly Secrets would be like an egg striking a rock. I humbly request Master to guide me—how should I grow stronger step by step?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng nodded with satisfaction: "The young can be taught. Your father was too impatient back then, which gave the Heavenly Eye a chance to exploit him." He drew from his sleeve a yellowed diagram covered in dense symbols. "This is the cultivation plan I've designed for you. First, complete the Tianji Record to the fifth page, and you'll be able to foresee changes within one day. Second, find your sister Chen Nian—she is the key to unlocking the Heavenly Fate Lock. Third, unite all forces that can be united—the Holy Sect Saint Su Qingyao, the geniuses of Xuanwu Sect, even your sworn enemies—use them all if you can." Mo Xiansheng's gaze turned sharp. "Remember, in this world, there are no eternal enemies, only eternal interests."

A faint tremor suddenly came from deep within the ruins, and Mo Xiansheng's expression shifted slightly. "Someone is coming." He lowered his voice as his form began to fade. "People from Tianqing Sect—and more than one." Chen Ji frowned. This was the Forbidden Grounds of Tianqing Sect; only sect elders could enter. He quickly tucked his father's Jade Slip close to his body and checked whether any traces had been left behind. Mo Xiansheng's form had become nearly invisible, yet his voice clearly echoed in Chen Ji's ears: "Remember, don't mention anything that happened here to anyone. Not even Su Qingyao."

Footsteps drew nearer. Chen Ji quickly adjusted his expression, taking a servant's token from his chest to disguise himself as a unfortunate disciple who had accidentally wandered into the forbidden grounds. He deliberately smeared dust on his face and tore a corner from his sleeve to make himself look disheveled. "Who is inside?" A commanding voice rang out, followed by figures appearing from the end of the corridor. Chen Ji recognized the leader—Tianqing Sect's former Patriarch, Ling Yuan. His electric gaze swept over Chen Ji, and a meaningful smile curved his lips: "Oh? Chen Ji? What are you doing here?" That smile sent a chill down Chen Ji's spine. He knew this former patriarch was far from what he appeared.

dialogue.content: "Reporting to the Patriarch, this disciple was merely chasing a wild rabbit and somehow got lost..." Chen Ji put on an expression of extreme fear, his voice trembling. "This disciple knows his mistake and begs the Patriarch's punishment!" His performance was flawless—the groveling, humble posture made the surrounding Inner Disciples show contempt: truly a废物, can't even walk without getting lost. Ling Yuan gazed at him deeply, those eyes seeming to pierce through his soul. But after a moment, the former patriarch simply waved his hand dismissively: "Enough. This is no place for you. Leave." Chen Ji practically crawled out of the ruins.

text.content: It wasn't until he had walked far from the ruins that Chen Ji dared to relax his taut nerves. His palms were soaked with cold sweat. In that moment of eye contact with Ling Yuan, he had clearly felt a faint killing intent. This former patriarch definitely knew something. "You did well." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his mind, carrying a hint of approval. "But from now on, you must be even more careful. Ling Yuan is extremely scheming. Your father trusted him too much back then, which led to his downfall." Chen Ji silently nodded, carving these words into his heart. He knew that from this moment on, there would inevitably be a life-and-death battle between himself and Ling Yuan. Until then, he must endure, must lie low, must make himself strong enough.

dialogue.content: "There's one more thing I must tell you." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly grew solemn. "Regarding your sister Chen Nian's whereabouts, I've found some clues. After the Holy Sect took her, she was imprisoned in a place called the 'Heavenly Fate Altar.' That altar is one of the projection sites of the Heavenly Eye in the mortal realm. It needs to use the special Heavenly Fate Lock within Chen Nian's body to complete some unspeakable ritual." Mo Xiansheng paused. "If you want to save her, you must become ten times, a hundred times stronger than you are now. Otherwise, going there would only mean death." Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, a firm light flickering in his eyes: "I will. For Father, for my sister, for all the poor souls manipulated by the Heavenly Eye—I will drag it down from its divine throne!"

text.content: Night wind brushed across Tianqing Sect's mountain peak. Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff's edge, gazing at the rolling mountains in the distance. His father's Jade Slip in his arms emitted waves of warmth, as if silently encouraging him. He took out the Jade Slip and gently pressed it to his forehead, feeling the presence of that remnant soul. "Father, rest assured." He whispered in his heart. "I will certainly complete your unfinished cause, will certainly make the Heavenly Eye pay the price." Mo Xiansheng's form flickered behind him, an expression of relief appearing on his weathered face. "Excellent," he murmured. "You are more of a chess player than your father. Given time, you will surely surpass him and become the true Lord of Heavenly Secrets." The night wind howled. Chen Ji's shadow stretched long under the moonlight, like a sword about to be drawn from its sheath, waiting for its destined moment.
